links.outcome: Physician-reported workflow disruption and burden from AI in primary care
links.effect: Physicians reported workflow disruption due to excessive system prompts and increased cognitive and emotional strain; qualitative, no quantitative effect sizes.
links.quote: Conversely, physicians reported concerns about workflow disruption due to excessive system prompts, lack of algorithmic transparency, increased cognitive and emotional strain, and perceived threats to clinical autonomy and accountability.

links.outcome: Physician-reported lack of algorithmic transparency of AI systems
links.effect: Physicians raised concerns about lack of algorithmic transparency; transparent and explainable systems were named a crucial prerequisite for implementation.
links.quote: Conversely, physicians reported concerns about workflow disruption due to excessive system prompts, lack of algorithmic transparency, increased cognitive and emotional strain, and perceived threats to clinical autonomy and accountability.

screen.reason: Qualitative interview study exploring primary care physicians' perceptions, lived experiences, and attitudes toward AI integration in clinical workflows.
